question: Can generic primitive composition after experience-derived coordinate acquisition discover unfamiliar operator rules, rather than receiving a predefined affine family?
claim_limit: Constrained grammar program synthesis and cycle-based coordinates, not arbitrary representation invention, general intelligence or complete training replacement.
world: Hidden latent index 0..N-1 and arbitrary label bijection fixing0, latent action0 (i+1)%N except broken_spine hash. Positive action1 is a deterministic seeded 3-primitive composition; negatives are deterministic hash, quadratic modular and broken-spine. No family label/decoder/oracle supplied to learner.
representation: N real action0 transitions from start; only if every raw label is distinct and terminal=start, write raw-to-cycle and inverse coordinate registers. No arbitrary source queries, no free reset.
grammar: Program generator composes 1..3 primitives from INC,DEC,ROL1,ROR1,XOR_BIT_i for every bit. Length-then-lexical order and canonical transform-function dedup. Generic operator search, no family-specific templates; fixed primitives/depth are supplied.
learning: Stream all action1 observations into exact fact memory; eliminate inconsistent program hypotheses. Predict unobserved only upon unanimous surviving program output; otherwise abstain. If version-space empty, retain facts and abstain. Source family hidden.
active_policy: Following cycle acquisition, select 12 as-yet-unobserved action1 input coordinates maximizing candidate output Gini diversity with lexical tie-break, navigate by actual action0, perform action1, count all actions/replies. No evaluator oracle or arbitrary-state injection.
control_arms: same-trajectory frozen WSP50 affine and WSP47 raw polynomial banks
independent exhaustive batch grammar search with identical data (must tie)
randomized action1-probe strategy with matched real action budget in independent policy arm
metrics: whole-process source actions, calibration and costs incl compilation, inference, reference
observed fact retention, cold canonical restore/tamper rejection
parity across encodings, negative confidence, program catalog size, rank, version-space cardinality

thresholds.positive: At least 95% correct on truly unobserved action1 queries for positive families, across encodings and widths, with zero incorrect confident predictions; >=20 percentage point absolute gain versus strongest non-oracle frozen comparator where cases exist.
thresholds.negative: At least 90% abstention on random_map and quadratic_second unobserved queries after 12 probes; zero false-known on negative. Invalid-cycle certification must reject learned coordinates. Retain 100% observed facts.
thresholds.engineering: Full inherited WSP01-50 and focused tests, Windows/Linux, exact reproducible trace, clean source and G29; parent WSP50 fully qualified first.
thresholds.classification: DEV_SUPPORTED only on all preset thresholds; valid misses MIXED; custody/parity/fact failure INVALID. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS without stronger fully trained neural and symbolic controls.

authority: External synthetic draft only; no official loop, merge, accepted refs, private runner, protected first-use, scheduler, deployment or live action.
first_use: No PRIMARY until final source/atlas and tests frozen; preserve negatives; no post-DEV tuning.
